scenarios.planned_action: Render the family-aware package operation plan without invoking a package manager.

rollback.trigger: A precondition or approval is absent.
rollback.last_safe_state: Fixture baseline only; no host state was captured.
rollback.action: Discard the generated plan and retain the fixture baseline.
rollback.verification: Re-run the validator; no system state is asserted.

scenarios.planned_action: Describe configuration validation and a bounded service transition without contacting a service manager.

rollback.trigger: Configuration validation or the defined health check would fail.
rollback.last_safe_state: Fixture baseline only; no service state was captured.
rollback.action: Stop before the transition and retain the known-good plan.
rollback.verification: Re-run the validator and require the failure state to remain visible.

scenarios.planned_action: Describe a reviewed rule change with an exact target and confirmation boundary without changing firewall state.

rollback.trigger: The target, authority, or recovery rule is not explicit.
rollback.last_safe_state: Fixture baseline only; no firewall state was captured.
rollback.action: Reject the plan and preserve the prior fixture record.
rollback.verification: Re-run the validator; no network policy is claimed to have changed.

scenarios.planned_action: Describe a capacity check, snapshot decision, and reversible storage plan without touching a filesystem.

rollback.trigger: Capacity, snapshot, or restore evidence is unavailable.
rollback.last_safe_state: Fixture baseline only; no filesystem state was captured.
rollback.action: Stop before allocation or deletion and escalate the evidence gap.
rollback.verification: Re-run the validator; no data-loss boundary is asserted.

scenarios.planned_action: Describe restore prerequisites, rollback triggers, and post-restore checks without restoring data.

rollback.trigger: Backup identity, integrity, or restore verification is missing.
rollback.last_safe_state: Fixture baseline only; no backup or host state was captured.
rollback.action: Do not restore; retain the blocked recovery handoff.
rollback.verification: Re-run the validator and keep system and production evidence unassessed.
